newThisWeek.name: just volleyball
newThisWeek.shortDescription: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!

newThisWeek.name: Retro Endurance 8bit
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Created by zsKnight of ZSNES is this really neat retro game collection containing a fun shuffler story mode and a challenging arcade mode. Features 52 different 8bit style games which includes local competitive multiplayer and various different game modes to play and enjoy.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Created by zsKnight of ZSNES is this really neat retro game collection containing a fun shuffler story mode and a challenging arcade mode. Features 52 different 8bit style games which includes local competitive multiplayer and various different game modes to play and enjoy.

newThisWeek.name: 流火 A Glimmer
newThisWeek.shortDescription: “A Glimmer”is a FMV . Set in 1940’s China, the protagonist takes the identity of agent Wang Qiming. Navigates bandits, National Revolutionary Army, Japanese‑puppet forces and Communist underground groups. Choices between justice, personal revenge and self‑identity bring totally distinct endings.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: “A Glimmer”is a FMV . Set in 1940’s China, the protagonist takes the identity of agent Wang Qiming. Navigates bandits, National Revolutionary Army, Japanese‑puppet forces and Communist underground groups. Choices between justice, personal revenge and self‑identity bring totally distinct endings.

newThisWeek.name: 10 Second Mixtape
newThisWeek.shortDescription: ¡Crea minimúsica con otras personas por internet! Un juego creativo y relajado con cocreación asíncrona. Compón canciones únicas con instrumentos disparatados, o simplemente pasa el rato viendo cómo los grupos de otros jugadores se suben al escenario.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Make mini music with other people online! A creative, low-stress game with async co-creation. Make unique songs with crazy instruments, or just hang out and watch other players' bands take the stage!

newThisWeek.name: HARMA
newThisWeek.shortDescription: HARMA es un juego de construcción de mazos roguelike de alta dificultad que combina una historia dura con una experiencia de juego extremadamente desafiante. Los demonios están destruyendo este mundo. Lucha contra los males del mundo en un destino irracional. Y demuestra que estuviste aquí.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father. Harness the power of mighty artifacts to defeat demons and save a world on the brink of destruction.

newThisWeek.name: Func Key
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Func Key is a word-spelling roguelike deckbuilder where your keyboard is your class: six boards, six different ways to play. Spell words, build your board, and bend the rules with mods, all to the soothing thock of the mechanical keyboard.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Func Key is a word-spelling roguelike deckbuilder where your keyboard is your class: six boards, six different ways to play. Spell words, build your board, and bend the rules with mods, all to the soothing thock of the mechanical keyboard.

newThisWeek.name: The Cozy Funemployment
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

newThisWeek.name: Ikemen Big Bang: A Dating Game About Potentially Hot Guys
newThisWeek.shortDescription: “That customer today might turn hot! Maybe you should trust your gut and try dating him!” Encouraged by your pet chinchilla, you start a trial relationship on a hunch! Will he actually turn hot… or not!? A romantic comedy Otome game. Fully voiced (except for the protagonist).
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: “That customer today might turn hot! Maybe you should trust your gut and try dating him!” Encouraged by your pet chinchilla, you start a trial relationship on a hunch! Will he actually turn hot… or not!? A romantic comedy Otome game. Fully voiced (except for the protagonist).

newThisWeek.name: Granule
newThisWeek.shortDescription: A physics sandbox about Murray, who didn't let a witch merge onto the highway. She sent him to The Granule, and something already lives there. You. Burn, freeze, shock, slice, and mend him. None of it is scripted, and the room is not all there is.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: A physics sandbox about Murray, who didn't let a witch merge onto the highway. She sent him to The Granule, and something already lives there. You. Burn, freeze, shock, slice, and mend him. None of it is scripted, and the room is not all there is.

newThisWeek.name: Don Memo
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Don Memo es un valiente toro que emprende un último viaje a través de Costa Rica para rescatar a su nieta y enfrentar al Pisuicas. Lucha contra leyendas y sombras del pasado en este pixel platformer 2D, mientras cargas con el legado de una familia destinada a proteger al mundo del mal.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Don Memo is a brave bull who embarks on one final journey across Costa Rica to rescue his granddaughter and confront Pisuicas. Fight against legends and shadows of the past in this 2D pixel platformer, while carrying the legacy of a family destined to protect the world from evil.

newThisWeek.name: My Little Ranch
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Un acogedor rancho de caballos que vive en tu escritorio mientras trabajas, o en pantalla completa cuando no. Cría caballos únicos, haz que galopen juntos, compite por monedas, contrata ayudantes y haz crecer tu rancho.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Breed one-of-a-kind horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch helpers and grow your ranch.

newThisWeek.name: Who Gave Them Weapons
newThisWeek.shortDescription: What happens when historical and fictional icons find an arsenal of crazy weapons? TOTAL CHAOS! Build a team with legends from fiction or history, discover unexpected builds and synergies, take on solo challenges or beat your friends in PvP battles in this absurd and hilarious auto-battler.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: What happens when historical and fictional icons find an arsenal of crazy weapons? TOTAL CHAOS! Build a team with legends from fiction or history, discover unexpected builds and synergies, take on solo challenges or beat your friends in PvP battles in this absurd and hilarious auto-battler.

newThisWeek.name: Dig! Dig! Dino!
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Dig Dig Dino! is a game about digging... For dinosaurs bones and other treasure!
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Dig Dig Dino! is a game about digging... For dinosaurs bones and other treasure!

newThisWeek.name: Maiden Party
newThisWeek.shortDescription: «Maiden Party» – ¡un RPG de cartas tipo *idle* con estética anime! Colecciona cientos de chicas en formato Live2D, crea tus propios mazos para librar batallas estratégicas y obtén recursos incluso cuando no estés jugando.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Maiden Party, an anime waifu idle card RPG. Collect hundreds of Live2D maidens, build decks for tactical battles and gain rewards offline. Explore fantasy dungeons, farm & fish in your homestead, raid world bosses with guildmates and unlock character bonds.

newThisWeek.name: Sardoinky
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Sardoinky is a weird, chill, hand drawn clicker about opening cans of sardines. Buy a can, crack it open and sell whatever is inside. Spend the cash on better cans and upgrades. Collect every fish and find out what the company is hiding.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Sardoinky is a weird, chill, hand drawn clicker about opening cans of sardines. Buy a can, crack it open and sell whatever is inside. Spend the cash on better cans and upgrades. Collect every fish and find out what the company is hiding.

newThisWeek.name: The Reverend: A Happyhills Homicide Story
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Unravel the dark secrets of Reverend Lawrence, known for his appearance in The Happyhills Homicide 2: Out For Blood. Prior to his death, Reverend Lawrence was a devout Christian and an example for the community of Happyhills. Everyone has skeletons in their closets, but some more than others...
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Unravel the dark secrets of Reverend Lawrence, known for his appearance in The Happyhills Homicide 2: Out For Blood. Prior to his death, Reverend Lawrence was a devout Christian and an example for the community of Happyhills. Everyone has skeletons in their closets, but some more than others...

newThisWeek.name: Shadow at Noon
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Noon casts the shortest shadows. A honkaku mystery told as an interactive sound novel: every clue is in black and white, on pages you've read. Amesaka, winter 2015. A son lies dead at the foot of the stairs; by morning the housekeeper has confessed. The soup spilled on the steps is still warm.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Noon casts the shortest shadows. A honkaku mystery told as an interactive sound novel: every clue is in black and white, on pages you've read. Amesaka, winter 2015. A son lies dead at the foot of the stairs; by morning the housekeeper has confessed. The soup spilled on the steps is still warm.

newThisWeek.name: Topdeck Automat
newThisWeek.shortDescription: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself! Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: The roguelike auto-battler where your deck prints itself! Supply a brave worker droid with synergistic blueprints to defend the planet against hordes of alien invaders. Combine hundreds of cards with custom upgrades and infinitely stackable modules to discover broken builds.

newThisWeek.name: Monk & The Misfit Monsters
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Disfrázate de diablillos y ayúdales a cumplir su sueño: viajar al Oeste, conseguir las escrituras sagradas y convertirse en Buda. Un RPG de grupo relajado, con arte dibujado a mano y combate automático para luchar, mejorar y superar pruebas con unos monstruitos muy graciosos.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Disguise yourself as little demons on a pilgrimage West to become Buddha! A cozy, hand-drawn party-based RPG with auto-battle, so you can easily fight, upgrade, and clear trials with a cast of funny misfit monsters.

newThisWeek.name: Malignus
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Un simulador de colonias en el que juegas como la mazmorra: su Amo, sus esbirros y las bestias de sus cuevas. Excava salas, monta y conecta trampas mortales y saquea tesoros en la superficie. Luego defiéndelos de los héroes que vienen a recuperarlos. Juega solo o con hasta 3 amigos en cooperativo.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: A dungeon colony sim where you play the dungeon itself: its Boss, its minions and the beasts in its caves. Dig out halls, wire deadly traps, and raid the world above for treasure. Then hold your hoard against the heroes who come to take it back. Play alone or in 2–4 player co-op.

newThisWeek.name: Widget Idle
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Tu escritorio es su mando. Cada clic, cada pulsación de tecla y cada movimiento del ratón lo ayudan a crecer. Widget Idle vive tranquilamente en un rincón de tu escritorio mientras tú te dedicas a las cosas más importantes de la vida. Ahora con una pizca más de felicidad :)
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Your desktop is its controller. Every click, keypress, and mouse movement helps it grow. Widget Idle lives quietly in the corner of your desktop while you get on with the more important things in life. Now with a little extra happiness :)

newThisWeek.name: Ludoman
newThisWeek.shortDescription: **Ludoman** es un simulador de vida ambientado en una Rusia cubierta de nieve. Paga una hipoteca de 250.000 rublos, trabaja, apuesta tu dinero y explora un mundo abierto. Una sola vida, libertad total y múltiples finales. ¡Tu destino está en tus manos!
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: **Ludoman** is a life simulator set in snowy Russia. Pay off a 250,000-ruble mortgage, work, gamble your money, and explore an open world. One life, complete freedom, and multiple endings. Your fate is in your hands!

newThisWeek.name: Pocket Pilots
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Pick a job at a real airport, watch your plane fly it in real time, and get paid when it lands. A relaxed flight career over the real world, with live weather, thousands of airports and pilots from everywhere sharing one sky.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Pick a job at a real airport, watch your plane fly it in real time, and get paid when it lands. A relaxed flight career over the real world, with live weather, thousands of airports and pilots from everywhere sharing one sky.

newThisWeek.name: Bunny Eureka
newThisWeek.shortDescription: A little island full of bunnies. Have them farm and build homes, or do nothing and just watch them eat, sleep and play. Now and then, visitors bring new stories, and the bunnies write you letters.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: A little island full of bunnies. Have them farm and build homes, or do nothing and just watch them eat, sleep and play. Now and then, visitors bring new stories, and the bunnies write you letters.

topMonth.name: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure
topMonth.shortDescription: Dashoot es un juego de plataformas de precisión en pixel art. Dispara a interruptores y mueve plataformas con tu cañón flotante. Recoge objetos para impulsos con distintas cargas, direcciones y distancias. Traza rutas subterráneas, reactiva centrales y descubre los secretos de la IA Deus.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a pixel-art precision platformer. Fire your floating cannon to trigger switches and move platforms. Grab items to dash with varying charges, directions and distances. Chart a path underground, restart power stations, and uncover the AI Deus's secrets.

topMonth.name: Funeral for the Sun
topMonth.shortDescription: Entre las cenizas de un pueblo abandonado y desentierra 400 años de maldición, encontrarás una historia de amor, traición y revolución. Sé testigo del pasado con tus propios ojos, descubre una red de secretos y revela la siniestra verdad de lo que duerme bajo los escombros.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

topMonth.name: DESKTOP BUG KILLER
topMonth.shortDescription: This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves. Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves. Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.

topMonth.name: just volleyball
topMonth.shortDescription: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!

topMonth.name: Love in Summer
topMonth.shortDescription: Se acerca el verano y consigues un trabajo de fotógrafo en el campus. Te acompañan Liu Shilin, cariñosa; Li Feier, fría pero cálida por dentro; Xia Wei, modelo traviesa; y Le Tong, amiga de la infancia. Juntos preparan las fotos de graduación. Con ellas empieza tu verano de emociones…
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Summer nears. A campus photo job brings you to caring beauty Liu Shilin, aloof yet warm artist Li Feier, mischievous model Xia Wei, and childhood friend Le Tong. Together, you plan graduation shoots, each lending your talents, as your own summer romance with four unique girls quietly begins.

topMonth.name: Bottled by Bears
topMonth.shortDescription: ¡Únete a una familia de osos y administra el apiario más dulce del mundo! Colecciona y descubre abejas únicas, llena frascos de miel, expande tu granja y mira cómo florece tu campo en este acogedor juego idle de gestión.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

topMonth.name: MATE, This Place is a MESS!
topMonth.shortDescription: MATE, This Place is a MESS! es un juego cozy de ordenar 5.000 paquetes de yerba en un museo hecho un caos. Llená los estantes, cebate un mate, desbloqueá habilidades y pateá paquetes a su lugar. Al fondo del salón, un telón enorme esconde la verdad del museo. ¿Cuál será?
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: MATE, This Place is a MESS! is a cozy organizing game where you sort 5,000 yerba mate packages in a messy museum. Fill the shelves, brew your mate, unlock abilities and kick packages into place. At the end of the hall, a huge curtain hides the truth about the museum. What could it be?

topMonth.name: Can 'Em All
topMonth.shortDescription: Un satisfactorio juego incremental en primera persona sobre convertir criaturas adorables en latas. Mátalas, recoge sus cuerpos, enlátalas y véndelas. Gana dinero, mejora tus armas y máquinas, y produce cada vez más.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

topMonth.name: Aviassembly
topMonth.shortDescription: ¡Construye y pilota tu propio avión! Completa misiones para ganar dinero, mejora tu avión y descubre nuevas ubicaciones en un mundo abierto.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Build and fly your own airplane! Complete missions to earn money, upgrade your plane, and discover new locations in an open world.

topMonth.name: Desktop Duck
topMonth.shortDescription: Tu escritorio se merece un pato. Vive en tu pantalla, se posa en tus ventanas y reacciona a ti. Consigue sombreros en compañía y luego intercámbialos, véndelos o presume de ellos.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Your desktop deserves a duck. It lives on your screen, perches on your windows, and reacts to you. Earn hats together, then trade, sell, or show them off.

hiddenGems.name: Stick A Fork
hiddenGems.shortDescription: ¡Un juego incremental adorable y lleno de dopamina! Basta con pasar el cursor. Clava tenedores en fruta gigante para ganar oro, compra más tenedores y elige bendiciones que formen sinergias. ¡Machaca la fruta, conviértela en mermelada y gástala en habilidades poderosas!
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: A cute incremental game packed with dopamine! Just hover. Stab forks into giant fruit for gold, buy more forks, and pick Boons that stack into big synergies. Smash the fruit into jam and spend it on powerful skills!

hiddenGems.name: Retro Endurance 8bit
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Created by zsKnight of ZSNES is this really neat retro game collection containing a fun shuffler story mode and a challenging arcade mode. Features 52 different 8bit style games which includes local competitive multiplayer and various different game modes to play and enjoy.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: Created by zsKnight of ZSNES is this really neat retro game collection containing a fun shuffler story mode and a challenging arcade mode. Features 52 different 8bit style games which includes local competitive multiplayer and various different game modes to play and enjoy.

hiddenGems.name: HELENA : Cloud District
hiddenGems.shortDescription: HELENA: Cloud District is an atmospheric first-person exploration game where you explore a decaying mega-structure to photograph strange plants and uncover fragments of melancholic memories.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: HELENA: Cloud District is an atmospheric first-person exploration game where you explore a decaying mega-structure to photograph strange plants and uncover fragments of melancholic memories.

hiddenGems.name: Sushiamo
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Sushiamo es un roguelike de construcción de mazos donde haces sushi para alcanzar puntuaciones absurdas. ¡Descubre ingredientes únicos, salsas, herramientas que cambian el juego y navega por el mapa para romper el juego con combos de locura!
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!

hiddenGems.name: Oboro no Ichi
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Construye y gestiona un mercado espiritual inspirado en Japón, da la bienvenida a espíritus errantes, produce y vende recursos y haz crecer tu espacio entre recuerdos y una atmósfera acogedora.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

hiddenGems.name: 流火 A Glimmer
hiddenGems.shortDescription: “A Glimmer”is a FMV . Set in 1940’s China, the protagonist takes the identity of agent Wang Qiming. Navigates bandits, National Revolutionary Army, Japanese‑puppet forces and Communist underground groups. Choices between justice, personal revenge and self‑identity bring totally distinct endings.

Navigates bandits, National Revolutionary Army, Japanese‑puppet forces and Communist underground groups. Choices between justice, personal revenge and self‑identity bring totally distinct endings.

hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: Make mini music with other people online! A creative, low-stress game with async co-creation. Make unique songs with crazy instruments, or just hang out and watch other players' bands take the stage!

hiddenGems.name: GloveUp!
hiddenGems.shortDescription: GloveUp! is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters, shape unique fighting styles through abilities, unlock outfits, level up and take on tougher opponents and challenges.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: GloveUp! is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters, shape unique fighting styles through abilities, unlock outfits, level up and take on tougher opponents and challenges.

hiddenGems.name: HARMA
hiddenGems.shortDescription: HARMA es un juego de construcción de mazos roguelike de alta dificultad que combina una historia dura con una experiencia de juego extremadamente desafiante. Los demonios están destruyendo este mundo. Lucha contra los males del mundo en un destino irracional. Y demuestra que estuviste aquí.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father. Harness the power of mighty artifacts to defeat demons and save a world on the brink of destruction.

hiddenGems.name: Fangtopia
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Híncale el diente a Fangtopia, un acogedor y relajante juego de rompecabezas en el que construyes paisajes terroríficamente paradisíacos con casillas de terreno para simpáticos monstruos. Crea un mundo que dé escalofríos de pura ternura sin preocupaciones ni sustos.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: Sink your teeth into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a carefree, scare-free world of gentle chills.

hiddenGems.name: Fat Chance
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Escapa de la mansión antes de que te reclame. Un cooperativo de terror para 1–5 jugadores.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: Escape the mansion before it claims you. A 1–5 player co-op horror.

hiddenGems.name: One More Floor
hiddenGems.shortDescription: One More Floor es un breve juego incremental. Baja en ascensor a las minas, da en el blanco para multiplicar tus monedas en cada planta y cobra antes de morir. Desbloquea nuevas minas, colecciona gemas raras y compra mejoras de prestigio permanentes.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: One More Floor is a short incremental game. Ride an elevator into the mines, hit the targets to multiply your coins each floor, and cash out before you die. Unlock new mines, collect rare gems, and buy permanent prestige upgrades.

upcoming.name: No Asteroids
upcoming.shortDescription: An asteroid will hit Earth in 90 days. The government held a tender, and one miner came with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. Dig 5,000,000 m³ in first person, sell the ore, and buy guns for your ship that fire while you dig.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: An asteroid will hit Earth in 90 days. The government held a tender, and one miner came with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. Dig 5,000,000 m³ in first person, sell the ore, and buy guns for your ship that fire while you dig.

upcoming.name: Am I Nima
upcoming.shortDescription: Am I Nima es un juego de terror psicológico en el que tendrás que convencer a tu madre de que eres su hija de verdad. Junta palabras en tu cerebro para expresarlas y lograr que ella confíe en ti.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

upcoming.name: Dirt Town
upcoming.shortDescription: Use incredible physics to create roads by pushing dirt, felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel. Dig a pit for resources, build a race track for the dirt bike! Get paid and buy more machines. Multiplayer for up to four players
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Use incredible physics to create roads by pushing dirt, felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel. Dig a pit for resources, build a race track for the dirt bike! Get paid and buy more machines. Multiplayer for up to four players

upcoming.name: SHRED A BILLION
upcoming.shortDescription: SHRED A BILLION es un juego incremental en primera persona sobre una montaña de dinero. ¡Coge billetes con las manos, recógelos con un cubo, sube de nivel y échale mil millones de dólares a la trituradora! ¡Solo quedan 3.929.120.202 billetes!
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 3,929,120,202 bills left to go!

upcoming.name: Drunken Goddess Reflux
upcoming.shortDescription: Juega a una ruleta rusa de chupitos con una diablilla que siente por ti un amor de los que matan. Se trata de un juego de supervivencia donde o provocas que ella vomite su alma o será la tuya la que potes. Cuanto más bebas, más reglas podrás saltarte... te lo pasarás de muerte.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

upcoming.name: Rec Room: A New Semester
upcoming.shortDescription: Party up with your friends and explore a world of endless fun. Hang out in official rooms, discover community-created rooms, or create unforgettable memories with players from around the world.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Party up with your friends and explore a world of endless fun. Hang out in official rooms, discover community-created rooms, or create unforgettable memories with players from around the world.

upcoming.name: Reshine
upcoming.shortDescription: Restaura antigüedades limpiando las capas de polvo, óxido y el paso del tiempo. Reshine es una experiencia minimalista y relajante. Usa herramientas para ver cómo años de suciedad desaparecen ante tus ojos. Sin complicaciones, sin presión, solo la satisfacción de devolver vida a tesoros vintage.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

upcoming.name: Lost Bitcoin
upcoming.shortDescription: Lost Bitcoin es un juego de excavación y automatización en una gigantesca chatarrería. Recoge chatarra, quémala para conseguir monedas, compra mejoras y construye una fábrica que trabaje para ti. Abre cajas y cajas fuertes, y revisa cada memoria USB para encontrar tu monedero de Bitcoin perdido.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Lost Bitcoin is a digging and automation game set in a gigantic junkyard. Collect scrap, burn it for coins, buy upgrades and build a factory that works for you. Crack crates and safes, and check every USB stick to find your lost Bitcoin wallet.

upcoming.name: TROLLHEIM: GNOMES
upcoming.shortDescription: Ponte en la piel de un gnomo y explora un bosque vivo en esta aventura de supervivencia PVE y multijugador inspirada en el folclore nórdico. Recolecta recursos, fabrica y construye un hogar para tu familia de gnomos en los árboles y conoce a los Väsen. Juega en solitario o con hasta 8 jugadores.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Explore an ancient, living forest as a tiny gnome in this co-op PVE survival crafting adventure inspired by Nordic folklore. Gather, craft and build a home for your gnome family amongst the treetops, and encounter the Väsen, mythical beings both friendly and dangerous. Play solo or up to 8 players

upcoming.name: Dear Passengers
upcoming.shortDescription: Juega en cooperativo como la tripulación de la peor aerolínea del mundo. Tu avión se cae a pedazos, tu carga es ilegal, y la seguridad de los pasajeros apenas entra en la lista de prioridades.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

upcoming.name: Shark Mart
upcoming.shortDescription: Shark Mart es un simulador cooperativo loco sobre tiburones infiltrados disfrazados de delfines amigables. Gestiona la tienda, limpia ballenas y secuestra peces desprevenidos para cocinar deliciosos platos. ¡Pero cuidado! La Policía de los Peces quiere descubrir vuestro secreto dentado...
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...

upcoming.name: Me and You
upcoming.shortDescription: Me and You es un juego de puzles cooperativo inspirado en el aclamado “Baba Is You”. Crea, cambia y rompe las reglas de cada nivel para resolverlo juntos.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

upcoming.name: PC Store Together
upcoming.shortDescription: Run your own PC shop with friends! Build and repair computers, diagnose faulty parts, stock shelves, set prices, sell hardware and custom PCs, serve customers, manage orders, upgrade your store, unlock new components and grow your business together.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Run your own PC shop with friends! Build and repair computers, diagnose faulty parts, stock shelves, set prices, sell hardware and custom PCs, serve customers, manage orders, upgrade your store, unlock new components and grow your business together.

upcoming.name: GrimKeep
upcoming.shortDescription: GrimKeep es un roguelite de composición de dados inspirado en un cuento de hadas de pesadilla. Encuentra objetos, tira los dados y optimiza tu build para desatar un daño brutal. Ábrete paso entre los horrores de la ciudad maldita hasta llegar a la Princesa. Y luego acaba con ella.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

upcoming.name: No Mercy
upcoming.shortDescription: Un crudo shooter en primera persona de estilo Bodycam donde un golpe de Estado fallido sume la ciudad en el caos. Ábrete paso por calles controladas por bandas, descubre la verdad sobre la desaparición de tu esposa y recupera lo que te arrebataron, bala a bala.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.

upcoming.name: My Child New Beginnings
upcoming.shortDescription: My Child New Beginnings is a parenting simulator where you go through everyday life of growth. After a series of traumatic events that you and your child went through, you now get to rebuild life together in a new region of Norway.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: My Child New Beginnings is a parenting simulator where you go through everyday life of growth. After a series of traumatic events that you and your child went through, you now get to rebuild life together in a new region of Norway.

upcoming.name: Split Brain Samsara
upcoming.shortDescription: Tu amigo y tú están atrapados en el mismo cuerpo. En esta aventura cooperativa, aprende a controlar el mismo personaje, aventúrate en el plano espiritual y revela la conspiración de la megaestructura Samsara. ¡La comunicación es la clave!
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: You and your friend are locked in the same body! In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure! Communication will be key!

upcoming.name: Book Nook
upcoming.shortDescription: Construye dioramas en miniatura, pieza a pieza. Coloca muebles, decoraciones y pequeños detalles hasta completar cada rincón. Relájate, disfruta de ver cada pieza encajar y descubre la historia que esconde cada Book Nook.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

upcoming.name: VacBot Simulator
upcoming.shortDescription: ¿Alguna vez te has preguntado qué siente tu aspiradora robótica cuando deambula por tu casa? Recogiendo tus desórdenes, dejando tus suelos impolutos de nuevo. ¡No te preguntes más! Experimenta las alegrías de limpiar varias casas a través de los LIDARs de varias aspiradoras robóticas sentenciosas.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Have you ever wondered what your robotic vacuum feels when it's wandering through your house? Picking up your messes, leaving your floors pristine again. Wonder no more! Experience the joys of cleaning various houses through the LIDARs of several judgemental robotic vacuums.

upcoming.name: Eletta
upcoming.shortDescription: Eletta es un juego de acción y aventura travieso en el que conviertes el entorno en un arma, creando trampas ingeniosas y caóticas para burlar a los enemigos de formas tan hilarantes como ligeramente maliciosas.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Eletta is a mischievous action-adventure where you turn the environment into a weapon, setting up clever and chaotic traps to outwit enemies in ways that are equal parts hilarious and slightly devious.
